content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in the early part of the forecast horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Underestimates prices in the final 5–10 days of the forecast, particularly when true values show strong upward momentum.
- Tends to overshoot after sharp price spikes (e.g., 80+ → 85+), then fails to correct downward in subsequent days.
- Shows persistent bias toward higher values in the middle of the forecast, especially when historical mean is rising.
- Fails to capture mean reversion in the final 5–10 days when true values revert to prior levels after a spike.
- Overreacts to recent volatility, leading to exaggerated forecasts in the first 5–10 days after a spike.
- Underestimates the magnitude of late-stage price corrections after a spike, especially when true values show a sharp drop.
- Model exhibits lag in adjusting to new information, particularly when true values deviate from historical trends in the last 5–10 days.
